name: echora
rule: a spatial commit may attach one room or add one permanent feature; it may remove nothing

rooms.label: the threshold
rooms.observation: the entrance remained after arrival. nothing on either side remembers opening it.

rooms.label: echo gallery
rooms.observation: each sound returns from a wall whose position is not contained by the plan.

rooms.label: borrowed wall
rooms.observation: one wall carries the dimensions of a chamber that is not attached to it.

rooms.label: second landing
rooms.observation: the stair arrives twice. neither landing admits being the first.

rooms.label: room behind the room
rooms.observation: the rear wall opens only after the room in front of it has been left.

rooms.label: false exterior
rooms.observation: the sky has corners. weather gathers along the ceiling line.

rooms.label: unlit stair
rooms.bearing: toward a lower floor that does not descend
rooms.observation: the final step is worn at its center, though no foot can reach it.

rooms.label: window room
rooms.observation: the window opens onto the record itself. the same mark is visible from both sides.

commits.change: the first surviving room was fixed around an open boundary
commits.learning: a boundary can remain even when arrival is forgotten

commits.change: a chamber was attached where the first room returned a sound
commits.learning: an echo proves distance, but not its shape

commits.change: a second lintel preserved the height of a door that never arrived
commits.learning: a revision can be kept without erasing its first form

commits.change: a room was attached to contain a measurement from elsewhere
commits.learning: a measurement can describe something no longer present

commits.change: five marks were retained where the borrowed measure met the wall
commits.learning: repetition becomes evidence when it leaves a mark

commits.change: a second landing was attached to the same descent
commits.learning: sequence alone cannot prove which landing came first

commits.change: three steps were fixed beneath a floor that does not lower
commits.learning: a route may remain after its destination is gone

commits.change: the rear wall became the parent of another chamber
commits.learning: some rooms appear only through the act of leaving

commits.change: an exterior was attached without leaving the structure
commits.learning: an outside can be represented without being reached

commits.change: two ceiling lines remained where open sky should have continued
commits.learning: a boundary can be known by where motion stops

commits.change: a stairwell was attached beneath a descent with no lower floor
two interior frames preserved the decreasing return of the echo
commits.learning: each return changes the scale of what returned

commits.change: a room was attached around the first mark another observer could verify
commits.learning: memory becomes evidence when another observer can return to the same mark

commits.change: a shallow groove was retained across the first threshold
commits.learning: repetition leaves direction before it leaves meaning
